qa.note: The Bundesnetzagentur power plant list dated 26 June 2026 shows the row IPH Strom GTX1, 54 MW, started 2003, with Infraserv GmbH & Co. Höchst KG as the plant operator. A register operator is not proof of ownership, so I did not report it as an owner source. Infraserv's own pages that I could load call it the operator of Industriepark Höchst but do not state ownership of this unit. The press release pages returned a server error. I saw no sign that the owner differs from GEM's value.
